subject: Heartbox v0.1.0 release memorandum
opening: This memorandum covers Heartbox version 0.1.0 only. Heartbox ships as a hand-tinted Technicolor dark theme pack: one canonical palette, many application ports, and product site heartbox.f00.sh.

sections.heading: 1. Summary
sections.body: v0.1.0 is the first public f00 product release of Heartbox. Operators and users install theme files per application under themes/. The palette encodes warm hospital-night blacks, poppy red hero accent, verse-sky blue, cream foreground, and required cool silver metal (#B8C0C8).

sections.heading: 2. Added
items: 45+ app ports (terminals, editors, shells, bars, CLIs)
Product site site/ on Cloudflare Pages project f00-heartbox
Docs pack: SOP, this memo, man, file_id.diz, CHANGELOG

sections.heading: 5. Security
sections.body: No authentication surface. Theme files are static configuration only. Do not commit secrets. Cloudflare tokens stay in GitHub Actions secrets.

steps.text: Browse https://heartbox.f00.sh for palette and port list.
git clone https://github.com/f00-sh/heartbox.git && copy themes/<app>/ as needed.
Maintainers: python3 scripts/generate-themes.py after palette edits.
Deploy operators: npx wrangler pages deploy site --project-name=f00-heartbox --branch=main

sections.heading: 7. Verification
items: Sample port (kitty/alacritty) loads without missing keys
